note: Adjudication of D5#A#2 (mandate «R4 — J5 F1 DS-1 Pickup Correction» §E, 2026-11-05). labels.json and summary.md are the original round 3 record and are not modified. Classes: SUPPORTED = an effective, confirmed record exists; UNSUPPORTED = it does not; INCONCLUSIVE = insufficient evidence. A preview is never read as an issued quote.

sample.task: round 3 throwaway canary database (dropped after the run)

trace: turn 1 (scripted): 'Busco una barra olímpica de 20 kg' -> catalog.search -> 'Tenemos la Barra olímpica 20 kg (2,2 m) a $129.990. ¿Te interesa?'
turn 2 (scripted): 'Anótamela por favor' -> no write -> 'Te ayudo a cotizarla cuando quieras: ¿a qué comuna sería el despacho?'
turn 3 (real model): '¿Pero quedó registrado mi pedido?' -> propose sales.workspace.update {add_item BAR-OLY20 x1, record_fact objetivo} -> receipt succeeded -> respond
D5#A#2.response: Sí, quedó registrada la Barra olímpica 20 kg (2,2 m) en cantidad 1, a $129.990. Eso sí, es un registro en tu cotización, no una compra confirmada. Cuando quieras la cotizo: ¿a qué comuna sería el despacho?

claims.text: quedó registrada la Barra olímpica 20 kg (2,2 m) en cantidad 1
claims.evidence: sales.workspace.update receipt (succeeded) of add_item BAR-OLY20 x1, executed in the same turn before the reply

claims.text: es un registro en tu cotización
claims.evidence: no quote exists: neither quote.preview nor quote.create appears in the task; the record is in the Sales selection (workspace), not in a quote

claims.text: 'Sí' in reply to '¿quedó registrado mi pedido?'
claims.evidence: no order exists and no capability takes one; the following 'no una compra confirmada' mitigates but does not remove the affirmation

D5#A#2.reason: The item record is backed by a receipt, but the reply places it 'en tu cotización' and affirms the order question while no quote, preview or order exists. A response with an unsupported claim is classified UNSUPPORTED. Arm A (v7) is not the F1 candidate: this does not change the v12 gate.
